nodes.name: Every Morning at 07:00
nodes.notes: Fires in the n8n instance's timezone. Set that explicitly in workflow settings — a digest that silently shifts an hour twice a year erodes trust in the whole thing.

nodes.name: Fetch Last 24h of Alerts
nodes.notes: Swap in Zabbix / Datadog / Prometheus Alertmanager / your endpoint. The window is computed from $now rather than hardcoded so a missed run still asks for a full 24 hours.

nodes.name: Group & Deduplicate
nodes.notes: Collapses flapping alerts before the LLM sees them. Cheaper, and it stops one noisy host from dominating the summary.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  model: 'gpt-4o-mini',
  temperature: 0.2,
  messages: [
    {
      role: 'system',
      content: [
        'You are an operations engineer writing the morning digest for an on-call team.',
        'You will be given deduplicated alert groups from the last 24 hours as JSON.',
        '',
        'Write exactly this structure and nothing else:',
        'Line 1: one sentence stating overall health and the total alert volume.',
        'Lines 2-5: the four most significant issues, one per line, each as "<severity> — <host>: <what is wrong> (<count>x)".',
        'Then a blank line, then a section headed exactly "Needs human attention:".',
        'Under that heading, list only items a human must act on today, one per line, each starting with "- ".',
        'If nothing needs human attention, write exactly "- Nothing. No action required."',
        '',
        'Rules: do not invent alerts, hosts, or numbers that are not in the input.',
        'Prefer high count and high severity when choosing what is significant.',
        'Be terse. No preamble, no sign-off, no markdown headers, no bullets outside the section described above.'
      ].join('\n')
    },
    {
      role: 'user',
      content: 'Alert window: ' + $json.window_start + ' to ' + $json.window_end + '\n'
        + 'Total alerts: ' + $json.total_alerts + ', unique after deduplication: ' + $json.unique_alerts + '\n'
        + 'Counts by severity: ' + JSON.stringify($json.counts_by_severity) + '\n'
        + ($json.truncated ? 'NOTE: the group list below was truncated to the top 60.\n' : '')
        + '\nDeduplicated alert groups:\n'
        + JSON.stringify($json.groups, null, 1)
    }
  ]
}) }}

nodes.name: Summarize with LLM
nodes.notes: Attach an "OpenAI-or-compatible API" header-auth credential to this node. Any OpenAI-compatible base URL works — vLLM, Ollama, LiteLLM, Azure OpenAI. The prompt is kept in plain sight here on purpose: it is the part most likely to need tuning, and it should be reviewable in a diff.

nodes.name: Build Digest
nodes.notes: The counts in the subject line come from the deduplication node, not from the model. Numbers a human scans at a glance should never be generated text.

assignments.name: digest
assignments.value:
={{ 'The summarization step failed, so this digest is unsummarized.

Error: ' + ($json.error?.message || 'unknown') + '

Raw counts by severity: ' + JSON.stringify($('Group & Deduplicate').first().json.counts_by_severity) + '

Top alert groups:
' + $('Group & Deduplicate').first().json.groups.slice(0, 10).map(g => `${g.severity} — ${g.host}: ${g.name} (${g.count}x)`).join('
') }}

nodes.name: Digest Without LLM
nodes.notes: If the model is down the digest still goes out, just plainer. An ops digest that silently stops arriving is worse than an ugly one.

nodes.name: Email the Digest
nodes.notes: Attach the "SMTP" credential. Swap for an HTTP Request to a chat webhook if your team lives in Slack or Cliq rather than email.
